decisions.reason: The multi-model operator line is central to the garage door system offer and cheap to maintain, and no evidence from 2020 to 2021 signals that its value has failed to materialize.
The solid wood door remains a niche option with unresolved demand, but keeping it in the configurable range costs little and supports the one-source offer, so abandoning it is not yet justified.
The remote-control operator complements the garage range at low holding cost, though there is some risk it gets merged into the broader operator line.
The glazed industrial door overlaps with sibling variants, but the lack of negative evidence and low cost in computer-controlled production favor keeping the option open.
Rising energy-efficiency requirements raise the value of the insulated glazed door, so its option value remains high.
Its prominent own-page presentation signals commitment, and nothing observed suggests its value will not be realized.
